notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for standard ownership transfer with regional update association state. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard region services, and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, callback model, and application configuration. It verifies regional registration and subscription, If Available acquisition, If Wanted divestiture, ownership queries, update-region association, source-region metadata, and cleanup without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador regional object and ownership services with FederateAmbassador discovery, ownership, and reflection callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador ownership, object-management, DDM, and attribute-update declarations with standard callbacks
